messages.content: Add a condition so that when age is above 65 she gets grey hair.

messages.name: get_form_state
messages.content: {"preset_id": "sdxl/base", "mode": "txt2img", "prompt_variables": ["age: number from 18 to 90 in steps of 1 \u2014 shuffles each generation"]}

Here is a version with the condition. It reads the existing number variable $age and falls back to auburn hair otherwise.

<tool_action type="update_segment" segment_index="1" segment_id="seg1">portrait of a woman, <<if $age > 65>>grey hair<<else>>auburn hair<<end>></tool_action>

Apply it from the card.
